authentication_method.description: The authentication method to use for the Facebook Pages connector. Possible values: `USER_ACCESS` (OAuth-based user access, default) or `SYSTEM_TOKEN` (System User Token).

pages.description: Specific pages to sync. Must be populated if `sync_mode` is set to `SpecificPages`.

sync_mode.description: Whether to sync all accounts or specific accounts. Default value: `AllPages`.

access_token.description: The `Access Token` carries the information necessary for API resources to fetch data. Use either `access_token` (for user access token) or `system_user_access_token` (for system token), not both at the same time.

client_id.description: `Client ID` of your Facebook  client application.

client_secret.description: `Client Secret` of your Facebook client application.

system_user_access_token.description: System User Token. Use in combination with `client_id` and `client_secret`. Use either `system_user_access_token` (for system token) or `access_token` (for user access token), not both at the same time.
